ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the recent developments in Medicaid fraud and the federal response
ideas.angle: Follow the money and track the flow of funds
questions: What are the specifics of the California case?
How does this relate to other states?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant fraud and abuse. By following the money and tracking the flow of funds, we can identify key players and patterns.
